stages.0: Reserved lot outline composed by runtime; no building image.
stages.1: Separate fence and south gate around the physical footprint.
stages.2: Same footprint with compact foundation, crane, cabin and materials.
stages.3: Approximately50%assembled with unchanged physical footprint, open opaque rooms, aligned partitions and rough masonry; no roof.
stages.4: Same shell and entrance, dark unfinished windows, approximately half the roof installed, no finished rooftop equipment.

overrides: New explicitly authorized variable compact families supersede the single 6x6 footprint. Keep the accepted high-45-degree frontal-top camera, all edges axis aligned. No heavy black outline, realistic brick texture, stretching, or image-height-based construction percentage.
normalization: One common aspect-preserving source frame derived from stage 5; identical transform for all stages; nearest-neighbour scaling, hard alpha and palette quantization only. Never redraw geometry, warp axes, or independently recenter a reverse stage.
sourceBackgroundRationale: Явный magenta chroma фон; двухобъёмный супермаркет с витриной и правым входом.
